stockCodes.title: Stock codes
stockCodes.description: 6-digit A-share codes (Shanghai and Shenzhen both supported), e.g. 000001, 600519. Leave empty to search the whole market.

category.title: Filing category
category.description: Restrict to one CNINFO disclosure category.

keyword.title: Title keyword (Chinese)
keyword.description: CNINFO matches this against filing titles only. Examples: 股份质押 (share pledge), 关联交易 (related-party transaction), 收购 (acquisition).

maxAnnouncements.title: Max announcements
maxAnnouncements.description: Hard cap on filings processed in this run. Each processed filing is a billable event.

extractEnglish.title: Extract English data
extractEnglish.description: On: download each PDF and produce an English summary plus structured, source-cited figures. Off: return filing metadata and PDF links only, at the much cheaper listing rate.

model.title: Model
model.description: Claude model used for extraction. Haiku is the cost-efficient default; Sonnet is more accurate on dense or unusual filings.

maxChars.title: Max filing characters sent to the model
maxChars.description: Long filings such as annual reports are truncated to this budget, keeping the document head plus the highest-scoring sections.

minRequestInterval.title: Minimum seconds between CNINFO requests
minRequestInterval.description: Politeness delay towards the CNINFO public endpoints. Values below 1 second are not allowed.

anthropicApiKey.title: Your own Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropicApiKey.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the included extraction service. Supply your own key if your organisation requires filings to be processed under its own Anthropic account.
